verdict.rationale: GitHub documents a public REST API for integrations and automation, plus a GraphQL API with a schema reference. Both are backed by date-based versioning with advance notice of breaking changes, fine-grained token permissions, and stable, generally available OpenAPI descriptions published in an official repository. The probe 404s at docs-site OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the descriptions are hosted in the github/rest-api-description repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Create integrations, retrieve data, and automate your workflows with the GitHub REST API.
The GitHub GraphQL API offers more precise and flexible queries than the GitHub REST API.
This repository contains OpenAPI descriptions for GitHub's REST API.
As of the 1.1.4 release, this description is considered stable and generally available.
Breaking changes will be released in a new API version. We will provide advance notice before releasing breaking changes.
Permissions define what resources the token can access via the API.
